crop.notes: Starts at the 'The Fight' subhead. The headline deck ('Hard Blows. A Rattling Glove-Fight in the Heart of Gotham...') and opening paragraph are cut off. The Allen mention is included.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, May 19, 1878, page 6. Special dispatch from New York, May 18.

facts.fact: Joe Goss beat Allen in their Kentucky fight on a foul, which the paper said Goss 'invented' himself

notes: Allen is named only once, in the description of Goss as one of Donovan's seconds. The fight date is not given in the article.
